title: ICE ORCA DRAGON research architecture competency questions
description: Stable ASK queries over the generated named RDF dataset. They protect programme boundaries, epistemic chains, route dependencies, and non-promotion invariants without evaluating scientific truth.

cases.question: Are the four programme descriptors separately addressable inside one collection?
cases.query: ASK WHERE { ?hyper a <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:ResearchGraphDescriptor> . ?hyper <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:key> "hypercomplex" . ?hyper <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:collection> ?collection . ?legacy a <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:ResearchGraphDescriptor> . ?legacy <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:key> "legacy" . ?legacy <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:collection> ?collection . ?cpt a <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:ResearchGraphDescriptor> . ?cpt <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:key> "cpt" . ?cpt <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:collection> ?collection . ?igrueqft a <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:ResearchGraphDescriptor> . ?igrueqft <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:key> "igrueqft" . ?igrueqft <urn:ice-orca-dragon:ontology:collection> ?collection . }
cases.rationale: The project is a collection of four independent evidence graphs, not one undifferentiated theory graph.

cases.question: Does Gate 1 retain both the explicit joint-cycle and source-derived-cycle subblockers?
cases.rationale: The two distinct G1 inputs must remain explicit rather than being flattened into a local solver task.

cases.question: Is the hard CFU gate still blocked by Gate 1?
cases.rationale: The ordered TOE-candidate spine must not silently bypass the current first gate.

cases.question: Is a direct G1 BLOCKED_BY edge to the P1 real-root supporting problem absent?
cases.rationale: P1 remains supporting until a separately reviewed typed source-to-cycle bridge exists.

cases.question: Does P4 record the resolved complex-tail result before the open endpoint and preserve Weyl-field-before-measure order?
cases.rationale: The completed fixed-UHP tail theorem must remain distinct from compact endpoint transport, nonreal Weyl and spectral-measure completion.

cases.question: Is a direct G1 BLOCKED_BY edge to the P4 RAQ umbrella absent?
cases.rationale: P4 is a supporting operator programme and not an inferred original-cycle prerequisite.

cases.question: Does quantum BFV common-core work remain blocked by classical closed-S3 HDA closure?
cases.rationale: P2-P3 must produce classical structure functions and closure data before P5 can audit a quantum BFV charge on a common core.

cases.question: Does the P7 likelihood lane remain downstream of quantum anomaly control and relational-observable construction?
cases.rationale: Likelihood must not be called before the physical-product, clock, state, generation, reheating and observable chain is available.

cases.question: Does the fixed-lambda P1 claim retain both supporting evidence polarity and its narrow scope?
cases.rationale: Computed support is meaningful only with its explicit evidence record, polarity and corridor scope.

cases.question: Is a Phase 57 ontology node absent from the frozen numbered route?
cases.rationale: The Ragnarok circuit breaker preserves Phase 51–56 provenance without minting a numbered descendant.

cases.question: Does the hypercomplex graph retain the Standard Model referent claim as inconclusive?
cases.rationale: Finite algebraic structure is not automatically a demonstrated physical interpretation.

cases.question: Does the legacy graph retain the declared P15 genuine-signal claim as contradicted?
cases.rationale: Narrative preservation must not erase the stored negative signal audit.

cases.question: Does the IG-RUEQFT graph retain the finite group-averaging bulk-locality shortcut as contradicted?
cases.rationale: The scoped finite negative result must remain visible.

cases.question: Does the IG-RUEQFT graph keep universal programme refutation inconclusive?
cases.rationale: One finite oracle does not decide all interacting or continuum realizations.

cases.question: Does the single choice-invariance promotion policy govern the CPT programme?
cases.rationale: One policy governs the CPT programme without creating cross-graph evidence links.

cases.question: Is the empirical likelihood bridge not directly blocked by the P1 real-root supporting problem?
cases.rationale: P1 cannot be made an inferred direct prerequisite of likelihood work.

cases.question: Is the empirical likelihood bridge not directly blocked by the P4 operator/RAQ umbrella?
cases.rationale: P4 remains a separate supporting operator chain, not a direct likelihood prerequisite.

guidance: These questions protect stable graph architecture and epistemic boundaries; they do not test the truth of the underlying physics.
A false-expected case encodes a deliberate absent relation or record and must be reviewed before changing it.
Do not add a competency case for every calculation; reserve the suite for durable collection, route and evidence invariants.
